page.layout: One page of running text, followed below it by a table of calendar columns: Indict., An. Iul. lit. dom., Nabon. (with Feriae.), a column of Mart. dates, and Christi. No margin notes. Running head at top with page number 464.

main_text.p: fuerint extincti:Dionysius enim eos apud Romanos dumtaxat abrogauit, qui apud Ægyptios, Arabes & Persas, aliosque populos orientales, usq; ad nostram ætatem constantissimè obseruantur. b Hocan-noChristi 622, die 16 Iunii, feria sexta, incipit æra Hegirae, & calendarii Arabici. c Hoc anno Christi 632, die 16 Iunii, feria Martis incipit æra Perfica, ad quam chronologiam sua deduxit Alfraganus. Quod autem hæc sit sedes æræ Perficæ, sine vlla controuersia ostendit Thoth Nabonafari 1380, qui tribus mensibus Perficis antecedit epocham Persicam: propterea Alfraganus noster cum cæteris Arabibus asserit, ante æram Persicam siue Iezdagirdicâ elapsos fuisse annos à Nabonafaro 1379, & tres menses Persicos siue Ægyptios.
main_text.l: Indict. | An. Iul. lit. dom. | Nabon. | Feriæ. | | Christi.

page.notes: The table is a calendar with Indict., Julian year, dominical letters, Nabonassar year, Feriae and Christian year columns. The Mart. references are placed beside the row where they stand in the printed table. A small "6" at the lower right corner, outside the table, was read as a possible signature or stray mark and is not transcribed. Inline letters b and c before the paragraphs are printed in the text itself and are transcribed as such. Spacing within numbers (e.g. 6 3 2, 1 3 8 o) is letter-spacing in print and is written as plain numbers.
